description: Defines template classes KeyValueType and TextKeyValueType for key-value pairs, including constructors, assignment operators, comparison operators, and key access methods.

classes.name: KeyValueType
classes.description: Template class representing a key-value pair with comparison and access methods.

classes.name: TextKeyValueType
classes.description: Specialized template class for text-based key-value pairs with case sensitivity options.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying or moving key-value pairs.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns a reference to the key.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns a reference to the value.

methods.name: IsKey
methods.description: Checks if a given key matches the stored key.

methods.name: HasKey
methods.description: Checks if the TextFragment key is non-empty (only in TextKeyValueType).

methods.name: IsKey (TextFragment)
methods.description: Checks key equality with case sensitivity consideration.
